map.由贷款额、利率与月供反推还款期数: Derive the Repayment Term from Loan Amount, Rate and Monthly Payment
map.输入贷款本金 P、每期利率 r、每期还款 PMT，求还款期数。: Enter loan principal P, periodic rate r and periodic payment PMT to find the number of repayment periods.
map.📖 查看「由贷款额、利率与月供反推还款期数 使用指南」: View "Derive the Repayment Term from Loan Amount, Rate and Monthly Payment User Guide"
map.n=ln(PMT÷(PMT−P·r))÷ln(1+r)，P 本金、r 每期利率、: n = ln(PMT ÷ (PMT − P·r)) ÷ ln(1+r), with P principal, r periodic rate and PMT payment. If payment ≤ periodic interest (PMT ≤ P·r) the denominator is non-positive and there is no solution — principal grows; the payment must be raised.
map.由年金现值公式反解 n。: Solve n from the annuity present-value formula.
map.已知月供能力反推多久能还清贷款。: Given the affordable monthly payment, work out how long it takes to clear the loan.
map.规划车贷/房贷还款节奏。: Plan the repayment pace of an auto or mortgage loan.
map.对比提高月供后期限缩短的幅度。: Compare how much the term shortens when the payment is raised.
map.贷款 50 万、月利 0.4%、月供 3,000 的还清期数: Payoff periods for a 500,000 loan, monthly rate 0.4%, monthly payment 3,000
map.月供低于利息会怎样？: What if the payment is below the interest?
map.若 PMT≤P·r（月息），分母 PMT−P·r≤0，公式无解——本金永远还不清: If PMT ≤ P·r (periodic interest), the denominator PMT − P·r ≤ 0 and the formula has no solution — the principal is never cleared and grows, a 'interest on interest' vicious cycle; the payment must be raised.
map.n 不是整数怎么办？: What if n is not an integer?
map.最后一期按剩余本金单独结算。通常前 n−1 期按整额月供，末期用剩余本金+利息凑: The last period is settled separately on the remaining principal. Usually the first n−1 periods use the full payment, and the final period uses remaining principal + interest to square up, with a slightly different amount.
